question: Should Hosted Feed v1 continue accepting the pre-standard 2026.7.2-beta envelope format alongside standard DSSE, and what concrete event authorizes removing that compatibility path?
rationale: This is a deliberate signed-catalog trust and upgrade-policy choice; automated review can verify parser mechanics but cannot choose the supported beta upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve the bounded beta bridge
options.body: Retain the all-or-nothing legacy parser only for the identified beta snapshots, record the removal trigger, and require fresh proof on the current PR head.

options.title: Require standard DSSE only
options.body: Remove legacy acceptance so all hosted catalogs must use the standard DSSE representation immediately.

options.title: Pause for a feed-contract decision
options.body: Defer merge until Hosted Feed owners define the supported beta migration and retirement policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded beta bridge
recommendation.body: Retain the all-or-nothing legacy parser only for the identified beta snapshots, record the removal trigger, and require fresh proof on the current PR head.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor to the DSSE consumer change and dependent feeds work, although the appropriate repository decision owner remains uncertain.
